purpose: Single mechanism removal patches for the inbox audit ablation matrix.

variants.expected_change: Allows audit target observation without requiring event.wake=true; authoritative human group/topic, sender, and scan-authority checks remain.
Makes the Host heartbeat dispatch predicate always true, while retaining the existing heartbeat timer and Agent iteration.
Removes the Agent CLI completion call so an audit read no longer marks pending rows completed; the normal audit JSON output remains.
Admits legacy v1 rows as pending v2 rows for measurement. This deliberately removes the provenance safety boundary and is an unsafe experiment.
Restores readFileSync loading and removes byte/row write and load caps while preserving v2 parsing, eligibility, pending lifecycle, and bounded diagnostics.

verification.method: git apply --check against a clean temporary tree at each variant baseSHA
